Fixes #7.

## Problem
\`refresh(session)\` in \`src/auth.js\` returned \`refresh(session)\` when the session was expired. The argument never changed, so it recursed forever and the page froze.

## Change
- \`refresh()\` now returns \`fetchSession()\` when the session is expired.
- Added an exported \`fetchSession()\` placeholder that throws \`fetchSession is not implemented\`.

## Open gap
The issue assumes \`fetchSession()\` already exists, but it is not defined anywhere in this repo. The placeholder makes an expired session fail with a clear error instead of hanging. A real implementation (endpoint, credentials handling) still needs to replace it.

## Testing
- \`node --check src/auth.js\` passes.
- \`refresh({expired: true})\` throws the placeholder error; \`refresh({expired: false})\` returns the session unchanged.
